metadata.title: Discrete geometry and de-Rham cohomology of graphs
metadata.abstract: We develop a theory of discrete spaces which are built by gluing coordinate patches together into an atlas, much as a manifold is built from charts. Graphs are the main examples, and an atlas on a graph gives it a geometric structure analogous to that of a manifold. This structure leads to a cohomology theory, which we show to be a discrete analogue of de Rham cohomology. We define a "discrete coordinatized space" as a cubical set equipped with the Alexandrov topology, on which differential forms become sheaves. When the atlas is regular, the de Rham cohomology agrees with the sheaf cohomology of the constant sheaf, just as in the smooth case. We compute it for several examples, including a torus graph and a graph resembling a sphere, and recover the cohomology of the corresponding surfaces.

analysis.workSummary: 以坐标图册拼接离散空间，将带 Alexandrov 拓扑的立方集上的形式组织成层；在正则图册下证明离散 de Rham 上同调与常值层上同调一致。
analysis.breakthrough: 为图的额外几何结构给出与光滑 de Rham 定理类比的桥梁，并计算环面和球面图例。
analysis.limitations: 结果依赖图册与正则性，不能直接看作无附加结构任意图的既定上同调。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
